title: Is your Postgres migration safe or not safe?
summary: A web tool that helps developers assess whether their PostgreSQL database migrations are safe to execute in production environments, providing guidance on avoiding potential data loss or downtime during schema changes.
problem_solved: Helps developers identify potentially dangerous database migrations that could cause downtime, data loss, or performance issues in production.
why_valuable: Prevents catastrophic database failures by providing safety checks before executing migrations, which is critical since bad migrations are a common cause of production incidents.
